name: git-on-path-agent
label: Git (agent)
description: git is on the PATH and runnable.

exe_data.prompt:
Capability to install: Git. Official page with install instructions: https://git-scm.com/downloads

Install Git on this machine so that `git --version` succeeds from a fresh non-login shell. Assume a bare machine. Prefer the platform's official package manager (apt-get/dnf/apk on Linux, Homebrew or the Xcode command line tools on macOS, winget on Windows). Do NOT configure user.name or user.email, do NOT set up credentials, and do NOT clone anything. Report the version you installed and stop.
